findings.function: spendableBalanceOf(address), transferableBalance(address,uint256), onTransfer(address,address,uint256) (and the other SafeMath64 users)
findings.lines: the vesting loop body after `while idx < vestingsLengths[address(_holder)]`
findings.source: Aragon SafeMath64.sub: require(_b <= _a, ERROR_SUB_UNDERFLOW) with string constant "MATH_SUB_UNDERFLOW" (solc 0.4.24)
findings.issue: The reason string is a constant just written to memory (length 18 and 'MATH_SUB_UNDERFLOW'), yet each check prints the whole copy-and-pad sequence with an unfolded length, a dead loop (`v = 32; while v < 18`) and two impossible branches instead of `require ..., 'MATH_SUB_UNDERFLOW'`.
findings.rule: Forward constant stores to later loads when the only stores in between are at `mem[64] + k` with mem[64] known to lie past the stored region; then fold the copy of a constant-length string (the loop runs a known count) into a string literal in the revert.

notes: Functions are 20-200 lines (forward is the largest); all reviewed. Source loops: TokenManager._transferableBalance's vesting loop, shown as `while idx < vestingsLengths[address(_holder)]` in spendableBalanceOf, transferableBalance and onTransfer. Not counted: MiniMeToken.getValueAt's `while (max > min)`, listed as reached but executed in the token contract behind the external balanceOf/balanceOfAt calls, so not in this bytecode. The other 30 whiles are solc-0.4 word-copy loops for revert strings and for the EVM-script/forward byte arrays (P7). P6: 37 lines (the 0x08c379a0 Error selector and similar printed with 63 digits). No semantic error found.
summary: Faithful, abort-free text whose one source loop is a clear while; it is bloated by solc-0.4 revert-string copy loops whose constant reasons are never folded into literals.
